coder_notes: Both registered arms are ACTIVE_COMPARATOR and both receive DCA; the difference is that DCA starts one week before surgery (pre-surgical arm) or 12-24 hours after surgery (control timing), so DCA is the sole investigational drug and is coded experimental_monotherapy, not control_comparator. The post-surgery-start arm functions as the no-pre-surgical-drug control for tissue pharmacodynamics. Tumour PK: the record plans blood and tumour tissue analysis of 'DCA dynamics' without stating whether drug concentrations are measured, hence unclear. GSTZ1 genotyping is a germline pharmacogenomic dosing factor and is not recorded as a tumour biomarker. Registry allocation is NON_RANDOMIZED although the summary says patients are randomized.
